# I Have a Meeting

> Agent skill: find, claim, fix, verify, integrate most important free issue before shared deadline.

Repository holds one skill, folder `i-have-a-meeting/` next to this file:

- [SKILL.md](i-have-a-meeting/SKILL.md): entry point, name and description frontmatter.
- `styles/persona.md`: base behavior for the run (reply shape, terse wording, minimal changes).
- `COORDINATOR.md`: maps symptom to methods.
- `methods/`: diagnosis and fix methods, loaded on demand.
- `agents/openai.yaml`: optional interface metadata.

Asked to install:

1. Install whole `i-have-a-meeting/` folder as skill the way your environment expects. Keep layout.
2. Personal or project scope unclear: ask user.
3. Existing copy differs: follow user's update instructions.

Installing does not run skill.
